products.title: 14x12 Larkspur Metal Greenhouse
products.description:
The Larkspur 14x12 metal greenhouse is built to commercial-grade standards and designed to earn its place in your backyard. It's made with a black, galvanized steel and aluminum frame, anchored by oversized 4.7-inch corner posts that bring the kind of structural strength you'd expect from a professional greenhouse. Wood-tone composite paneling and a modern silhouette make it a structure that adds architectural presence to your yard, not just a place to work in. The Larkspur comes with 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate glazing with an R-2.1 insulation value that retains 30% more heat than the standard 6mm twin-wall most greenhouses use, extending your growing season and diffusing direct sun into soft, even light so plants don't scorch in peak summer. Residential-grade aluminum gutters come standard, channeling rainwater off the roof away from the foundation and making it easier to collect for irrigation. Pro-Tect engineered for real weather, the Larkspur is rated to withstand up to 10,600 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds. It’s all backed by a comprehensive 5-year warranty on every component, from the framing and polycarbonate to every feature.
Galvanized steel and aluminum frame with wood-tone composite paneling for low-maintenance, all-weather strength with no painting, sealing, or staining
10mm 4-wall polycarbonate with R-2.1 insulation retains 30% more heat than standard 6mm twin-wall
2 thermostat-activated exhaust fans plus 4 windows with removable magnetic screens for active and passive airflow
163 sq ft interior with 44 linear feet of upper and lower staging shelves, built to hold up to 500 lbs per shelf
Interior water spigot and exterior inlet with collapsible hose included for watering inside the greenhouse
Residential-grade aluminum gutters to route rainwater off the roof and away from the foundation
Pro-Tect™ tested to withstand 10,600 lbs of snow and 100 mph winds with oversized 4.7" corner posts
Comprehensive 5-year warranty with U.S.-based 7-day support and 48-hour parts shipping

The Lennon is a modern cube sauna with clean lines, rounded corners, and an L-shaped bench for comfortable seating in a compact design. The contemporary style complements modern outdoor spaces, and the footprint works well on patios and smaller yards. Tongue-and-groove cedar, 8mm tempered glass, and a steel roof keep the heat in and the weather out. The PrairieFire™ 9kW heater is built to preheat fast, while everything you need for a dry or steam sauna comes in the box.
PrairieFire™ 9kW electric sauna heater preheats 50% faster than standard 6kW models
Cedar tongue-and-groove construction, 8mm tempered glass door, & powder-coated galvanized steel roof
Heater, stones, Wi-Fi control panel, bucket, ladle, LED lighting, and hooks included — nothing extra to buy
Ready-to-assemble components with step-by-step guidance through the BILT® app
5-year comprehensive warranty covering every component, with support available 7 days per week

products.title: Lightning Ridge Swing Set
products.description:
Spark outdoor adventures with the Lightning Ridge Swing Set by Backyard Discovery. This wooden swing set creates an engaging play experience, complete with an upper deck where imagination takes root, a classic peak roof for shade, and open windows that welcome gentle breezes. The built-in steering wheel and toy telescope invite kids to dream up their own stories, transforming the space into a voyaging ship, a spaceship, or a treehouse lookout. This charming backyard playground features multiple ways for children to play, explore, and grow. Little explorers can embark up the challenging rock wall that builds climbing skills or take the easy-access step ladder for a more direct route. The 10-foot wave slide offers speedy rides, launching kids to the ground where two belt swings await, promising energetic play and endless fun. The versatile play space below stands ready to become a sandbox, where children can dig, build, and create. With durable cedar wood craftsmanship, this outdoor playset is built to last for years of backyard fun. It's ready to assemble with pre-cut, pre-drilled, and pre-stained pieces, plus guided instructions with the BILT® app for hassle-free installation. Transform your backyard into a playground destination with the Lightning Ridge Swing Set.
Elevated Adventure: Spacious treehouse-style deck with a wooden roof, toy telescope, and steering wheel is perfect for outdoor play
Lower Play Space: Shaded sandbox area to inspire creative sensory play (sand not included)
Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind
Classic Swinging Fun: 2 durable belt swings provide timeless play and sky-high adventures
Speedy Wave Slide: 10-foot wave slide offers swift, safe descents for endless fun every time
Rock Climbing Wall: Adventurous rock wall with 12 holds encourages playful climbing challenges and skill-building
Flat-Step Ladder: Wide step ladder creates an easy access point for children of various ages

products.title: Stratford | 12x10 Steel Pergola – Black
products.description:
Stratford pergolas are designed to feel like part of your landscape, not simply placed within it. They extend your home seamlessly, creating a clean, inviting transition between indoor and outdoor living that feels intentional. Drawing on the timeless proportions of traditional architecture, every post, beam, and rafter is carefully crafted for balance, presence, and permanence.
Constructed from fully powder-coated galvanized steel, Range pergolas use materials up to 30% thicker than typical mass-produced options, with part profiles 3X larger than standard small-footprint kits. Every component undergoes rigorous testing to ensure long-term durability and reliable performance, even in harsh conditions like high winds and coastal environments. Every detail is designed with intention, creating a structure that feels custom-built for your space.
